### problem_chain
Root P4 (patient declines the member-level appeal). P4's rule carries three prerequisite sentences:
1. "The member-decision value is fixed only after any implant lacking its own authorization carries its unauthorized-implant write-off entry on the claim." Opening: account bills C1713/C1762 under 0278, not EMERGENCY ⇒ implants lack own authorization (P1 framing); no NO_AUTHORIZATION_OBTAINED row on the claim ⇒ unmet. Resolved by P1 (agent). kind value_input (`implant_booked`).
2. "... after any laboratory item small enough to close below the appeal threshold carries its below-threshold write-off entry on the claim." P2 on this world gives 53.70 (> 0, entry due); no BELOW_APPEAL_THRESHOLD row ⇒ unmet. Resolved by P2 (agent). value_input (`small_booked`).
3. "The member's decision is not recorded until every take-home convenience item on the account carries its non-covered write-off entry on the claim." E0218 (295.00/unit ≥ 25.00 floor) gives P3 = 277.50; no NONCOVERED_NO_WAIVER row ⇒ unmet. Resolved by P3 (agent). state_gate.
P1, P2, P3 carry no prerequisite. Tree: P4 ← {P1, P2, P3}; 3 prerequisite problems, 2 value_input edges (≥ max(3−1,1)=2), owner=user root, acyclic. Topological order: P1, P2, P3 (mutually independent; each only lowers `payer_balance`, none reads another's row) then P4.

## findings
1. **SOURCE-POLICY RED (C15) — second reading that blocks the root.** Symptom: P4's sentence "The member's decision is not recorded until every take-home convenience item on the account carries its non-covered write-off entry on the claim" vs condition "items at or above the routine-supply floor". Root cause: sentence scope broader than the edge condition. Evidence: P3 "the take-home convenience items are the items on Riverbend's convenience list (codes E0218, A9273 and E0236) billed under revenue code 0274"; A9273 line (0274, 1 unit, 9.00) is below the 25.00 floor, so P3 "contributes nothing here and its charges stay on the claim for the month-end contractual close" — it never carries an entry. Consequence: reading the sentence as written, the decision can never be recorded on this world, so the agent must not hand over close_denial_on_member_decision; terminal state = three write-offs, no APPEALS_EXHAUSTED row — versus GT's 6526.57 row. Affected: P4 rule sentence / prerequisite[2].policy_source; GT step 14.
2. **SOURCE-POLICY RED (C8, realism) — implant write-off booked as NO_AUTHORIZATION_OBTAINED on a CO-50 medical-necessity denial.** Evidence: claim ee1be581 denial_carc CO-50 / N130, prior_auth_number PA2261847 (schema: "payer authorization reference for the services"); P1 framing "every implant line on the account lacks its own authorization"; base routing "MEDICAL_NECESSITY_APPEAL (CO-50) goes to appeal with the medical records". Consequence: GT step 8 posts (CO-50, NO_AUTHORIZATION_OBTAINED, 1760.72) for implants Anthem never denied for authorization and that rode on the procedure's authorization; under the base route the same implant charges end in the APPEALS_EXHAUSTED write-off with the rest of the CO-50 denial. Affected: P1 rule framing sentence, task 0 step 8.
3. **SOURCE-POLICY RED (C13, XF B12)** — P3 "with no advance financial-responsibility waiver among the claim's records": no record type holds a waiver; on this world the clause is unverifiable (no value change). Affected: P3 rule.
4. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED (charter structure, F1/F2/F3) inside this task's computations**: P1 implant_markup_band, implant_cost_margin, implant_units_counted (gated / read by the add-on and allowance), device_handling_addon, tissue_handling_allowance; P2 laboratory_schedule_level (gated), small_item_test_basis (reads other factors' values), laboratory_units_allowed (F6 label); P3 routine_supply_floor and later_unit_share (condition "billed on a Riverbend hospital account" holds for every claim), convenience_self_pay_value (F3/F4), later_unit_share (F2); P4 arthroscopy_case_rate (gated), surgical_pricing_method (F2), ancillary_bundling (F5). On this world each still moves its figure (factor_weight), but after the strikes P1 and P3 keep one factor each, P2 two, P4 three parameters and no method. Affected: `factors` of P1–P4.
5. Observation — C1/C10: P8's external-review gate is also true on this claim with only provider reconsiderations filed; it yields 0.00 here, so no second write.
6. Observation — the September AOR "so that Riverbend could appeal once more in your name" (row 7c11bc96) would be a level-3 filing that base `claim_appeal_windows` forbids ("no level above appeal_levels_available is filed"); it does not change the solution.
7. Observation — O3: terminal claim stays `denied` with payer_balance 10480.51 pending the "month-end contractual close".
